sourceTitle: Choose the target to list files for
filterTitle: Show only files whose name or text contains the entered string
clearFilterTitle: Clear the search text and show all files
contentOnlyOn: Showing only added or modified files. Press to show all files
contentOnlyOff: Press to show only added or modified files (hides deleted, moved, copied and permission-only changes, and symbolic links)
resizerTitle: Drag to change the width (double-click to reset)
noNewline: No newline at end of file
spaceOnly: Only whitespace differs. Choose "Show" under "Whitespace" to see the difference.
noTextRows: There are no text lines to show.
symlinkNote: The diff of a symbolic link is the link target path.
fullMissing: The full text is not included. Showing the changed parts.
fileClose: Press to close the diff of this file
fileOpen: Press to open the diff of this file
commitsClose: Press to close the list of commits
commitsOpen: Press to open the list of commits
subjectShrink: Press to shrink the subject to 2 lines
subjectExpand: Press to show the whole commit message
openAllTitle: Open the diffs of all listed files
closeAllTitle: Close the diffs of all listed files
layoutUnifiedTitle: Stack the before and after lines vertically
layoutSplitTitle: Show before and after side by side
scopeDiffTitle: Show only the changed lines and a few lines around them
scopeFullTitle: Show the whole file and color the changed lines
spaceShowTitle: Show whitespace differences and mark changed whitespace with symbols
spaceIgnoreTitle: Show lines that differ only in whitespace (including full-width spaces, tabs and a CR at the end of a line) as unchanged lines. Added and removed blank lines are still shown
themeHybridTitle: Dark around the diff, light only in the diff part
noticeNoDiff: There is no difference in content.
noticeSubmodule: For a submodule, the diff of the referenced commit is shown.
noticeUnreadable: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 are shown as \xNN.
noticeNoFull: The full text cannot be restored from a diff file, so it is not included.
dataLoadError: The diff data could not be opened. The decoder may not have loaded, the integrity check may have failed, or the data could not be unpacked. A page built with --embed-decoder does not need the CDN.
